name: javascript-refactor
about: A rewrite of your JavaScript module (solution.mjs) that still passes your tests and returns exactly what the original returns on every case you give.
instructions: Return the complete rewritten module. Keep every export's name and signature.

original.about: the module as it is now

call.about: the exported function the cases call

cases.about: one call per line: a JSON array of the arguments (e.g. [3, [1, 2]]); cover the edge cases. Outputs must match exactly, so a change in float rounding counts
